faqs.q: Sec. 26-34. - Authorization to issue declaration of civil emergency, emergency, or disaster.
faqs.a:
The city manager is authorized to declare a civil emergency, emergency, or disaster
               if the city manager finds that the city or any part thereof is suffering from or is
               in imminent danger of suffering a natural or manmade civil emergency, emergency, or
               disaster.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
